name: Divine Right raises crit, parry and spell hit chance (#2204)
contract: Divine Right rank 1 (680631) and rank 2 (681469) are SPELL_ATTR0_PASSIVE stat auras, all three of native, family-agnostic types. Effect 0 is SPELL_AURA_MOD_CRIT_PCT (290) with EffectBasePoints 1/3 resolving to +2/+4; AuraEffect::HandleAuraModCritPct (SpellAuraEffects.cpp) calls Player::UpdateAllWeaponDependentCritAuras and Player::UpdateAllSpellCritChances on apply, so this is read by melee_crit_chance directly (the parity doc records that this core ignores aura 290's misc value and class mask, i.e. it is a straight, unconditional bonus). Effect 1 is SPELL_AURA_MOD_PARRY_PERCENT (47) with EffectBasePoints 1/3 resolving to +2/+4. Effect 2 is SPELL_AURA_MOD_SPELL_HIT_CHANCE (55) with EffectBasePoints 4/9 resolving to +5/+10. None of the three effects need a script or a spell_script_names row.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Rank 1 raises melee crit chance by 2
Rank 1 raises spell hit chance by 5
Rank 2 raises melee crit chance by 4
Rank 2 raises spell hit chance by 10
